name: Website Ventures Client Intake + Scope Gate
purpose: Capture the minimum commercial and production inputs needed before a client build starts, reduce scope creep, and transform approved inputs into the reusable Client Factory flow.
rules: This is an internal production gate, not legal terms or a signed customer contract.
No build starts until identity, primary CTA, services, service area and domain state are known.
Reviews, certifications, project photos, team claims and guarantees are real-source-only and must be supplied or verifiable.
Unknown inputs stay explicitly unknown; do not invent customer facts to make the website look complete.
Anything outside agreed sections/functions is a change request, not an invisible addition to the base job.
Revision allowance remains a commercial field until the final Website Ventures offer is locked.

included: selected reusable visual assets where relevant
basic domain/DNS connection once hosting model is approved
notIncludedByDefault: full rebrand/logo design unless explicitly sold
ongoing content management unless explicitly sold
paid third-party subscriptions or domain fees unless explicitly included
